candidate_mount: candidate.py and fixtures.json only, both read-only; oracle.json excluded
auditor_mount: source and hidden oracle read-only; candidate raw read-only; independent output directory writable
container_policy: Separate network-none, read-only-rootfs OrbStack containers; 16MiB bounded tmpfs; distinct output directories; do not touch any pre-existing container.
stop_rule: Candidate once; auditor once only if candidate exit 0. Preserve first failure and stop; no retry.
